biography.plain_text: Pierre Planade is a French entrepreneur who founded Pilauka, a business specialising in courtesy cars and long-term vehicle leasing. He built the company with his wife, Véronique, who served as president. After selling business interests, he returned to automotive services through OseCars, based near Limoux in the south of France.

long_biography.plain_text:
Small businesses are the focus of Pierre Planade’s automotive venture OseCars. Its membership model gives independent repairers, tradespeople and professional practices access to vehicle offers negotiated on terms usually associated with larger fleets. The service covers vehicle selection, finance arrangements and the return of cars at the end of their contracts.

Planade also developed an events business, initially organising business gatherings in Saint-Tropez. At the Château de Tournou in the Aude, he promoted a different setting for company meetings and private stays. The medieval property is offered to one group at a time, with seven bedrooms and arrangements for private chefs and local wine tastings.
